Definition: from G2730; residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion):--dwelling.
BiblicalUsage: Katoikesis means a dwelling, a residence. Mark 5:3 says the man with the unclean spirit had his dwelling among the tombs, and no man could bind him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe where a man dwells shows who rules him, and only Jesus could enter that graveyard and set him free.
